📋 AKITA TOP 10 COMPLETE TRAVEL CHEAT-SHEET:
• #1 Tamagawa Onsen (96/100pt) — pH 1.2 Acidic Volcanic Onsen (IG 50/50 | ★4.4)
  🚃 Access: Tazawako Stn + Bus 70m | 💡 Local Hack: Start in 50% bath; bring straw mat to fumaroles
• #2 Nyuto Onsen Village (90/100pt) — 7 Milky Forest Hot Springs (IG 43/50 | ★4.4)
  🚃 Access: Tazawako Stn + Bus 50m | 💡 Local Hack: Stay 1 night to buy ¥2,500 Yumeguri Pass + bus
• #3 Lake Tazawa (88/100pt) — Japan's Deepest Cobalt Lake (IG 48/50 | ★4.1)
  🚃 Access: Tazawako Stn + Bus 12m | 💡 Local Hack: Visit Goza-no-Ishi Shrine red torii on north shore
• #4 Oyasukyo Gorge (86/100pt) — 98°C Steam Canyon Geyser (IG 41/50 | ★4.4)
  🚃 Access: Yuzawa Stn + Bus/Car 50m | 💡 Local Hack: Wear grippy sneakers for 300 wet canyon stairs
• #5 Mototaki Waterfall (85/100pt) — Emerald Moss Spring Falls (IG 39/50 | ★4.5)
  🚃 Access: Kisakata Stn + Car 15m | 💡 Local Hack: Go at 8 AM for mystical morning mist & zero crowds
• #6 Namahage Museum (83/100pt) — 150 Demon Masks & Live Ritual (IG 40/50 | ★4.2)
  🚃 Access: Oga Stn + Shuttle 25m | 💡 Local Hack: Pre-book Namahage Shuttle taxi from JR Oga Station
• #7 Dakigaeri Gorge (82/100pt) — Turquoise Stream & Red Bridge (IG 40/50 | ★4.2)
  🚃 Access: Kakunodate Stn + Car 15m | 💡 Local Hack: Walk 30m to Mikaeri Falls; carry a bear bell
• #8 Kakunodate Samurai St (81/100pt) — Edo Samurai Black Fences (IG 39/50 | ★4.2)
  🚃 Access: Kakunodate Stn Walk 18m | 💡 Local Hack: Arrive before 3 PM; samurai interiors close at 4:30 PM
• #9 Senshu Park (81/100pt) — Kubota Castle Moat & Foliage (IG 43/50 | ★4.0)
  🚃 Access: Akita Stn Walk 10m | 💡 Local Hack: Climb Osumi Turret for panoramic views of Akita City
• #10 Cape Nyudozaki (80/100pt) — 40th Parallel Lighthouse & Sunset (IG 41/50 | ★4.1)
  🚃 Access: Hadachi Stn + Bus 50m | 💡 Local Hack: Time visit for Sea of Japan sunset & hot stone soup
